name: MenuItemCatalog
description: A menu item in a location's catalog.

deleted.description: Whether the menu item is marked as deleted.

available.description: Whether the menu item is available at the location.

openItem.description: Whether the operator can override the item name at the POS.

reportCategoryId.description: Unique report category identifier the item belongs to.

standardPriceAmount.description: Standard price of the item in US dollars, as a decimal string.

plu.description: Price look-up (PLU) identifier for the menu item.
